name: Daily Job Search + AI Match + Auto-Apply + WhatsApp Notify

nodes.name: Build Search Queries (per city)
nodes.notes: UPDATED: now reads Candidate Config + raw CV text + AI Agent's structured output directly (via $('NodeName') references) instead of relying on the removed 'Parse CV Profile JSON' and 'Merge CV Text into Config' nodes. candidatePhone/candidateEmail are now derived from the CV by the AI Agent rather than typed manually.

nodes.name: Search Jobs (JSearch API)
nodes.notes: FIXED: previously called /job-details with a hardcoded job_id and never sent the role/city query at all, so every run just re-fetched one fixed listing regardless of location. Now correctly calls /search with the per-combo query built upstream. country changed us -> in (JSearch scopes results by this param). date_posted widened 3days -> week to catch more candidates for the AI filter to evaluate. Fires once per role+city combo (2 roles x 4 cities = 8 calls/run) - watch RapidAPI free-tier quota. SECURITY: this key is hardcoded in the workflow JSON and was exposed in this file - rotate it on RapidAPI and move it to an n8n credential instead of a raw header.

nodes.name: Normalize + Dedupe Jobs
nodes.notes: Runs once for all city results, flattens them, and removes duplicate job_ids. City matching now expands common aliases (Gurgaon<->Gurugram, New Delhi/NCR<->Delhi, etc.) since the previous literal substring match silently rejected real listings that used the old/alternate city name.

nodes.name: Check If Already Seen (Sheets)
nodes.notes: IMPORTANT: your spreadsheet must have a tab literally named Applied_Jobs with headers: job_id, title, company, publisher, match_score, status, date, apply_link

nodes.name: Has Employer Email?
nodes.notes: Branch 1 of 3: true = a genuine employer email was found (mailto/JD text/page scan) -> auto-apply by email. false = falls through to 'Has Apply Link?' next.

nodes.name: Auto Apply (Send Email + CV)
nodes.notes: fromEmail now pulls from candidateEmail in Candidate Config automatically - no more hardcoded placeholder. toEmail is the employer address found by 'Find Employer Email (Autonomous)' (mailto/JD text/page scan) - never guessed. YOU STILL MUST: set your real address in Candidate Config's candidateEmail field, and connect real email-send credentials authorized to send AS that address on this node.

parameters.name: Body
parameters.value: ={{'✅ Applied for you via email to ' + $json.found_email + ': ' + $json.title + ' at ' + $json.company + '. Match score: ' + $json.match_score + '%.'}}

parameters.name: Body
parameters.value:
={{'⚠️ Found a matching job on ' + $json.publisher + ': ' + $json.title + ' at ' + $json.company + ' (match ' + $json.match_score + '%).
This site needs manual apply - please apply yourself here: ' + $json.apply_link + '

If asked screener questions, use:
Current CTC: ' + $json.currentCTC + '
Expected CTC: ' + $json.expectedCTC + '
Notice Period: ' + $json.noticePeriod}}

nodes.name: Log to Google Sheets (Memory)
nodes.notes: FIXED: sheetName was 'Applied_Jobs' - that's the SPREADSHEET's file name, not a tab. The actual tab in this sheet is 'Sheet1', matching what 'Check If Already Seen (Sheets)' reads from. Without this fix, applications would be logged to a non-existent tab while the lookup keeps checking Sheet1, so nothing would ever register as 'already seen'.

nodes.name: Attach CV Resume Binary
nodes.notes: Pulls the CV binary straight from the 'Download CV PDF (Google Drive)' node earlier in the workflow and attaches it to this job's item, so the email node can send the actual resume - no manual UI attachment step needed, and no separate/duplicate file is created.

nodes.name: Find Employer Email (Autonomous)
nodes.notes: Only jobs that already passed AI match threshold reach here (saves unnecessary page fetches). Tries mailto link, then JD text, then a no-login page scan, in that order. Deliberately skips scraping LinkedIn (login-gated - would require automating a real login, which violates LinkedIn's ToS and risks the account). Sets found_email='' when genuinely nothing is found, which the next node uses to route to WhatsApp manual-apply instead of guessing an address. | UPDATED: rebuilds the job record from 'Normalize + Dedupe Jobs' + 'Build Search Queries (per city)' and parses the Match Score Agent's structured output, since the removed 'Parse AI Response' node no longer does this merge.

nodes.name: Has Apply Link?
nodes.notes: Branch 2 of 3: only reached when no employer email was found. true = a direct apply link exists (covers almost every Indeed/Naukri/LinkedIn/Shine posting) -> WhatsApp the link for the user to apply manually. false = no email AND no link -> 'no apply method' notice.

parameters.name: Body
parameters.value: ={{'🔎 Found a matching job but no apply email or link was available: ' + $json.title + ' at ' + $json.company + ' (match ' + $json.match_score + '%). Publisher: ' + $json.publisher + '. You may need to search for it manually.'}}

nodes.name: WhatsApp: Notify No Apply Method Found
nodes.notes: Branch 3 of 3: fires only when a job passed AI matching but has neither a real employer email nor a usable apply link - so the user still hears about it instead of it silently vanishing.

options.systemMessage:
You are a resume-parsing assistant. You will receive raw, unformatted text extracted from a candidate's CV/resume PDF. Extract the candidate's profile accurately. Rules:
- total_experience_years: sum actual work experience only (exclude internships unless no other experience exists). Estimate from dates if not stated explicitly.
- top_skills: the candidate's strongest 5-8 skills, prioritizing what's emphasized or repeated across roles/projects.
- key_technologies: specific tools, frameworks, languages, platforms mentioned (e.g. "LangGraph", "Python", "AWS EC2") - not soft skills.
- certifications: only formal certifications/courses explicitly named. Empty array if none found.
- education: highest degree + institution + year, as a single string.
- summary: 2-3 sentences capturing seniority level, domain expertise, and specialization.
- email: the candidate's own contact email address, exactly as written in the CV. Empty string if none found.
- phone: the candidate's own contact phone number, exactly as written in the CV (keep the country code/format as given). Empty string if none found.
- If a field genuinely cannot be determined, use an empty string, empty array, or 0 - never invent information.

You are a strict job-matching assistant. Compare the candidate CV to the job description and produce a match score. Rules:
- match_score: an integer from 0-100 rating how well the candidate's CV fits the job.
- reason: one short sentence explaining the score.
- If the job description mentions a salary range clearly below the candidate's expected CTC, reduce the match_score and mention it in the reason.
- Never invent information not present in the CV or job description.

main.node: WhatsApp: Notify No Apply Method Found
